text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A massive stack of letters arrived for 
Curren Chan. It seems every single one of 
them is fan mail.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"Wah, so many arrived? Curren is so 
happy~♪"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, Big Brother. Is it okay if I 
read the letter here?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, Big Sister. Is it okay if I read 
the letter here?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"I was just thinking it might be a bit too 
much to carry back to the room~"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...Three cardboard boxes full of fan 
letters. They certainly would take up 
space if kept in a room."

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Thank you~♪ I'll take my time reading it♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With this sheer volume of letters, it'll 
likely take some time to read them all. 
...I should prepare something to drink.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"As I boil water and go to hand the 
freshly brewed tea to Curren Chan—"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"Big Brother, were those all the fan 
letters that were sent to this room?"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Big Sister, are all the fan letters 
received the ones in this room?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: I see. So that really was the last ticket.
choice_data_list: You've read all of it already?!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
That's right, you know? Because it's a 
letter from Curren's fan.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
If Curren were a fan of Curren, I'd want 
them to read it as soon as possible, you 
know?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. I'll post on Umastagram that I read 
the fan letters. Let's see here—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"And with incredible speed and accuracy, 
Curren Chan types out her replies to her 
fans."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...I felt like I understood a little bit 
of why her fans are so devoted to her."
